parameters.content:
## 06 · Re-engagement
Runs every 2 hours, acts rarely.

Hard rules: live `CONTACT_REMINDERS` consent · quiet hours respected · max 2 nudges, 72h apart · one opt-out is permanent · the message never reveals the topic.

Consent ledger, prior nudges and subject record are joined in a single aggregation.

assignments.name: vigorConfig
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const d = { agentServiceUrl: 'http://host.docker.internal:8000', internalToken: '', notifyMode: 'DEMO', oncallEmail: 'oncall@example-clinic.ae', escalationSlaMinutes: 60, quietHoursStart: 21, quietHoursEnd: 8, webhookBase: 'http://localhost:5678', envBlocked: true }; try { return { agentServiceUrl: $env.VIGOR_AGENT_SERVICE_URL || d.agentServiceUrl, internalToken: $env.VIGOR_INTERNAL_TOKEN || '', notifyMode: $env.VIGOR_NOTIFY_MODE || 'DEMO', oncallEmail: $env.VIGOR_ONCALL_EMAIL || d.oncallEmail, escalationSlaMinutes: Number($env.VIGOR_ESCALATION_SLA_MINUTES || 60), quietHoursStart: Number($env.VIGOR_QUIET_HOURS_START || 21), quietHoursEnd: Number($env.VIGOR_QUIET_HOURS_END || 8), webhookBase: ($env.WEBHOOK_URL || 'http://localhost:5678/').replace(/\/$/, ''), envBlocked: false }; } catch (e) { return d; } })() }}

nodes.name: Vigor config
nodes.notes: The only node that reads $env. Needs N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false, and falls back to defaults with envBlocked:true if that is missing.

nodes.name: Quiet hours check
nodes.notes: Checked before the query, so a quiet-hours run costs nothing.

parameters.query: ={{ JSON.stringify([{ $match: { status: 'started', startedAt: { $lt: $json.abandonedBefore }, nudgeStopped: { $ne: true } } },{ $sort: { startedAt: 1 } },{ $limit: 200 },{ $lookup: { from: 'consents', localField: 'pseudonymId', foreignField: 'pseudonymId', as: 'consentDocs' } },{ $lookup: { from: 'subjects', localField: 'pseudonymId', foreignField: 'pseudonymId', as: 'subjectDocs' } },{ $lookup: { from: 'notifications', let: { p: '$pseudonymId' }, pipeline: [{ $match: { $expr: { $eq: ['$pseudonymId', '$$p'] }, template: { $in: ['reengagement_nudge'] } } },{ $sort: { createdAt: -1 } }, { $limit: 5 } ], as: 'priorNudges' } },{ $project: { _id: 0, assessmentId: 1, pseudonymId: 1, locale: 1, startedAt: 1, answeredItemCount: 1, nudgeCount: 1, lastNudgeAt: 1, consentDocs: 1, subjectDocs: 1, priorNudges: 1 } }]) }}

nodes.name: Join abandoned intakes
nodes.notes: One round trip: abandoned assessments joined to the consent ledger, prior nudges and the subject record.

nodes.name: Apply nudge policy
nodes.notes: Every suppression reason is recorded, which is what lets workflow 08 report fairness across locale and age band instead of guessing.
